Hi Elaine,

Thanks again for taking the time today — enjoyed the discussion with you and the BrightBridge team. Quick recap and the MPA I promised attached below.

Key takeaways from the demo
- Primary evaluation goal: validate latency and cost on bursty search workflows (approx. 1.5k QPS day-of-week spikes)
- Success criteria: p95 <= 350ms and cost per 1k tokens < $0.90 for eval workload
- Security: SOC2 plus VPC peering required for procurement

What I attached / shared
- Attached: MPA_Redwood-BrightBridge_20270304.pdf (mutual action plan with milestones)
- Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cMPA (editable; suggested owners column highlighted)

Requests / proposed owners & dates
- Eval owner (BrightBridge): stakeholder TBD — suggested: Alice Kim, due 2027-03-18
- Procurement owner (BrightBridge): stakeholder TBD — suggested: Tom Garcia, target DocuSign by 2027-03-25
- Redwood owner (we've assigned): Marcus Lin (technical lead) and I (engage & Ops)

Can you do a quick rollcall on the BrightBridge side and confirm the owners above or suggest alternates? If those dates look off we can shift; just need a target so we can reserve dedicated test slots.

Thanks,
